name: finish_after_reconnect_late_transcript
description: SCA-4385 shape, synthetic. One origin; recording A (0-64 s) is cut off by a stream gap, the app reconnects into a new session and records B (129-154 s). The user taps Finish at 152 s while speaking continuously. A seals at 109 s but its batch transcript lands only at 184 s, after B's fast-finish provisional transcript (169 s). A 1.2 s device-sync fragment F from the start of A arrives at 162 s. The Finish conversation should hold A, B and F and be visible on Home.

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 at the merged head (265 reads, 75 writes, 1 delete(s), 8 no-op, 1 STT, 8 LLM; caps about +10%). noop_writes=8 is the current count, not a target: every one is database/conversations_v3_leases.py:72 renew (service.reconcile run_blocking renew) rewriting the lease until at the instant it was claimed. The lab clock does not move inside one event; production's does, so this is a lab-clock repeat, reported in the PR.
